## Summary

Resolves #462.
Closes #462.

/claim #462

This pull request introduces a comprehensive, developer-focused, code-complete tutorial for **Vectara Chat** under `tutorials/en/mastering-vectara-chat-grounded-conversational-ai.mdx`.

### What This Tutorial Covers
In strict compliance with the outline recommended in issue #462 and the repository editorial standards in `tutorials/README.md`:

1. **Introduction to Vectara Chat**:
   - The anatomy of conversational RAG vs stateless semantic search (handling anaphoric references, context drift, multi-turn memory).
   - High-level architecture: Boomerang neural retrieval, conversational turn session management, and factual consistency scoring.
2. **Getting Started with Vectara Chat**:
   - Setting up accounts, customer IDs, and corpora in the Vectara Console.
   - Programmatic document indexing via Vectara REST API v2 using Python (`requests` / SDK).
3. **Building a Conversational Assistant with Vectara**:
   - Initializing server-side chat sessions (`POST /v2/chats`).
   - Querying chat turns (`POST /v2/chats/{id}/turns`) with generative summarization.
   - Grounded citations: Parsing citation markers (`[1]`, `[2]`) directly to source document chunks.
4. **Enhancing Chatbot Intelligence**:
   - Hybrid search tuning with `lexical_interpolation` (combining BM25 exact matching with Boomerang dense neural embeddings).
   - SQL-like metadata filtering at search time (`doc.category = 'legal_terms' AND doc.effective_year >= 2024`).
   - Automated hallucination evaluation using the Hughes Hallucination Evaluation Model (HHEM-2.1) and `factual_consistency_score`.
5. **Deploying and Testing Chatbots (Streamlit Web UI)**:
   - A complete, runnable single-file Streamlit web app (`app.py`) featuring conversational memory, live parameter sliders, citation inspection drawers, and factual consistency score badges.
6. **Conclusion & Hackathon Blueprints**:
   - Actionable hackathon blueprints: *ReguGuard* (Regulatory compliance auditor), *MedProtocol* (Clinical trial advisor with hallucination guardrails), and *SaaS Multi-tenant Knowledge Co-pilot*.
   - Practical tips for winning hackathons with Vectara.

issue.title: Add comprehensive Vectara Chat tutorial
issue.body:
## Summary

This PR adds a comprehensive, hands-on tutorial for **Vectara Chat** for bounty issue #462. It teaches readers how to build a complete grounded chat experience with Vectara in Python, written in the first-person tutorial style used across the repo.

**File:** `tutorials/en/vectara-chat-tutorial-build-a-grounded-chatbot-with-citations-in-python.mdx` (~2,800 words)

## What the tutorial covers

Following the structure recommended in the issue:

- **Introduction to Vectara Chat** — grounded generation (RAG), numbered citations `[1]`, conversation memory, and the factual consistency score; links to the required [Vectara Beginner App Tutorial](https://lablab.ai/t/vectara-beginner-app-tutorial-showcase-the-creation-of-vectara-app-in-legal-use-case) and [Vectara Advanced App Tutorial](https://lablab.ai/t/vectara-advanced-app-tutorial-showcase-the-creation-of-vectara-app-in-legal-or-customer-support-use-case)
- **Getting Started with Vectara Chat** — account + personal API key via the Console, `VECTARA_API_KEY` environment variable, virtualenv, `pip install vectara`, and creating a first corpus with `client.corpora.create`
- **Building a Chatbot with Vectara** — ingestion with `CoreDocument` / `client.upload.file` (PDFs), single-shot grounded Q&A with `client.query`, printing `[1]`-style citations mapped to `search_results`, and multi-turn memory with `create_chat_session` + `ChatParameters(store=True)`
- **Enhancing Chatbot Intelligence** — `lexical_interpolation`, `context_configuration`, reranking (`CustomerSpecificReranker`), `response_language` (ISO 639-3), `max_used_search_results`, `max_response_characters`, `generation_preset_name` (Mockingbird), `CitationParameters`, factual consistency gating, and streaming with `query_stream`
- **Deploying and Testing Chatbots** — a complete runnable Streamlit `app.py` using the chat session, three concrete test cases (grounded / follow-up / out-of-scope), and deployment with `requirements.txt` + Streamlit Community Cloud
- **Conclusion and Tips for Hackathon Participants** — recap, use-case ideas, and practical tips (show citations, protect API keys)

## How API accuracy was verified

All code and parameters were checked against official, current sources before writing:

- Vectara REST API v1→v2 migration guide (endpoints, `corpus_key`, `response_language` codes): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/migration-guide-api-v2
- Grounded generation / RAG overview (citations, Mockingbird): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/learn/grounded-generation/grounded-generation-overview
- Official quickstart (`VECTARA_API_KEY`, `x-api-key` auth, Mockingbird preset, `[1], [2]` citations, factual consistency score): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/quickstart
- API key management (`x-api-key` header, permission profiles): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/security/authentication/api-key-management
- Console chat overview (chat toggle, chat history corpus): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/console-ui/vectara-chat-overview
- Python SDK chat guide (`create_chat_session`, `session.chat`, `ChatParameters`): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/sdk/python/chats
- Query API reference (generation config, citations styles): https://docs.vectara.com/docs/rest-api/query
- File upload endpoint (`POST /v2/corpora/{corpus_key}/upload_file`): Vectara REST API v2 reference
- Official `vectara` SDK (PyPI, v0.4.3): https://pypi.org/project/vectara/ and https://github.com/vectara/python-sdk

Additionally, every SDK class, field name, and method signature used in the tutorial (`SearchCorporaParameters`, `KeyedSearchCorpus`, `ContextConfiguration`, `CustomerSpecificReranker`, `GenerationParameters`, `CitationParameters`, `ChatParameters`, `QueryFullResponse.summary/search_results/factual_consistency_score`, `CreateTurnsChatsResponse.chat_id/answer/turn_id`, `client.query`, `client.query_stream`, `client.create_chat_session`, `session.chat`, `client.corpora.create`, `client.documents.create`, `client.upload.file`) was verified against the installed SDK v0.4.3 locally, so all samples are runnable as written.

Note: this tutorial intentionally uses the current v2 API / official Python SDK, which differentiates it from the existing `vectara-chat-essentials` tutorial in this repo that uses the older v1 request style.

/claim #462

> **Disclosure:** This PR was authored by @Furox-Art (AI-assisted). Happy to adjust anything.
